compiled_state.title: [Script Tests CI]: test-plugin-scripts-no-relative-paths.sh -> 3 violations after sprint script relocation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

CI Script Tests job on PR #36 (sprint skill renumbering + script relocation) fails with 3 violations in test-plugin-scripts-no-relative-paths.sh.

## Reproducer

\`\`\`
\$ bash tests/scripts/test-plugin-scripts-no-relative-paths.sh
Violations found:
plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/sprint-pause-state.sh:19:_PLUGIN_ROOT="\$(cd "\$_SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/sprint-review-scope-check.sh:42:TICKET_CMD="\${TICKET_CMD:-\$SCRIPT_DIR/../ticket}"
plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/sprint-drift-check.sh:86:TICKET_CMD="\${TICKET_CMD:-\${SCRIPT_DIR}/../ticket}"
FAIL: test_no_relative_paths_in_plugin_scripts
\`\`\`

## Expected vs Observed

**Expected:** All plugin scripts use \`\${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-...}\` resolution per the test convention; no bare \`../\` references.

**Observed:** Three sprint-scoped scripts moved to plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/ in PR #36 introduced bare \`../..\` and \`../ticket\` references for the new directory depth, missing the \`CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT\` env-var fallback wrapper that the test allowlist requires.

## Status

Inline fix already applied in worktree (uncommitted): wrapped each violating line with \`\${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-<original-relative>}\` pattern. Verified test passes locally; scripts still execute correctly.

comments.body: Classification: mechanical — 3 deterministic line-level fixes for plugin-scripts-no-relative-paths.sh test convention. Files in plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/ (not in skills/agents/prompts dirs). Routing to Mechanical Fix Path.
